record.reference: Telecom Egypt effected a 2-for-1 reverse split of the underlying ordinary shares while changing the depositary ratio from one GDR representing two ordinary shares to one GDR representing one ordinary share. The simultaneous ratio change preserved the U.S.-listed depositary receipt economics and count, so the canonical ETELY multiplier is 1.0; the 0.5 ACTIONS value and 2.0 SEP domain transition describe the offsetting underlying and depositary-ratio legs.
